page.layout: One page: the front board of a stamped binding, with a central panel and decorative border. Two metal clasps on the right edge. The Herzog August Bibliothek scan banner is below and is not transcribed.
page.notes: Front cover (binding), not a printed leaf. The central panel shows an embossed coat of arms above a rectangular label with two stamped lines of inscription, one reading "IOACHIM VON ALVENSCHLEBEN" and the other a shorter line above it. The top of the arch above the arms has a further stamped word, and the lines are partly worn and not reliably legible at this scan resolution, so they are not transcribed. The banner, scale and grey scale strip are digitiser material and are excluded.
